A.reference: pooled train/cal X incoming weights, frozen in batch QA before new test results
A.common_support: only cells with L and H in cal_select and evaluated role; record every gap and retained reference mass; renormalize fixed X mass on common support separately per class
A.threshold: strict score > t; lowest observed cal_select L score with standardized FPR <= alpha; threshold fixed on select, ties never split
A.ROC: standardized pooled ROC and within-cell ROC; normalized partial area to FPR .1
A.bootstrap: 500 component-stratified incoming draws per original role, saved views together; fixed predictions/calibration/thresholds; original split reused

T.algorithm: single L-BFGS-B weighted cal_post NLL; fixed old b and unchanged saved point; no restarts

B.QA: original cohort qa first40, source/X/status selected without labels
B.family: true associated unique cluster/SP and unassigned relative-muon activity where references exist; otherwise only actual collection-level counts/coordinates, absent references remain missing
B.native: exact production manifests/logs; no reconstruction, no inferred entry ratios, no cross-source run/event joins
